conventions.note: a source-stated interaction with another clock, or a genuine open term; never version history, rationale, provenance, a stage allocation, or anything a structured field already carries
conventions.seam: population.json owns the seam partition of Stage A producers; minted-row membership and seam counts are derived through producer_provision_version_id. closure_manifest owns only seam review and acceptance state.
conventions.anchor.legal_state.effect: a result token the named producer emits in A; no sentinels
conventions.anchor.resettable_period: {scope, start_event, reset_event, basis} — a period that restarts on the reset event; Stage C computes from the later of start and the last reset. basis names the evidence stream the source makes the conclusion rest on; what incomplete coverage of that stream does to the period is a legal question B does not answer
conventions.dispositions.expression: every temporal or quantitative expression that bears on the accepted operative meaning of the atomic Stage A row has one disposition; text repeated in a sibling atom's whole-clause source quote belongs to the atom whose accepted effect it qualifies, and every minted source_phrase is its own expression; clock/parameter dispositions omit expression and resolve it from the referenced row source_phrase; other disposition kinds retain their independently authored expression
conventions.parameter.value: scalar numeric string | {confidence, confidence_bound, design_prevalence, design_prevalence_bound} (unit percent) | {samples, tests} (unit count) | {from_month, to_month, wraps_year} (unit month) | {open_term, reserved_to}
conventions.completion: the act or fact that satisfies THIS clock's own condition; never a downstream decision the clock merely enables
conventions.bound: exact | floor | null; not_before and eligibility_threshold are always floor
conventions.window: biological qualifier of the clock's relationship (flight season, appropriate time); never a clock of its own
conventions.applies_when: source-stated applicability of this clock, including controlling exceptions and mutually exclusive alternatives; inherited Stage A meaning remains authoritative
conventions.legal_duty_owner: the source-level actor legally obliged to satisfy this temporal condition; domestic competence and execution follow the applicable Stage A allocation, never a blanket substitution of the current operator for the Member State; distinct from reserved decision owner and executor
conventions.executor: only where a source allocates one
conventions.consumer_decision: stable id of the decision the clock or parameter feeds
conventions.effective interval: Derived in the consumer view from the Stage A producer interval extended through immediately following versions whose semantic_change is NO; dates are not authored again in B.
conventions.consequence/completion: a_effect (token emitted in A) | a_version_performed (that version's true effect performed) | record (a fact in the operator's record) | none
conventions.dispositions: operative-expression grain: every in-aperture temporal or numeric expression bearing on its atomic Stage A meaning carries one disposition
conventions.acceptance_binding: accepted_content_sha256 binds the seam's conventions, minted rows, dispositions, the exact accepted Stage A artifact bytes, and population.json; a change to any input invalidates acceptance
conventions.recurrence: recurrence.period is cadence; recurrence.occurrences_per_period is a source-stated count; either may be null for an open recurrence. A biological occurrence window remains in window. calendar_deadline carries a source-stated annual date.
conventions.parameter.legal_effect: OPERATIVE | CONDITIONAL | CONFLICT_RETAINED; a conflict-retained source number is evidence of the conflict, never an operational permission
conventions.parameter.applies_when: source-stated condition on the parameter's legal effect; null only when unconditional
conventions.parameter.dependencies: stable Stage A propositions that control or qualify the parameter
conventions.dispositions.aperture: IN_APERTURE | EXTERNAL_ANCHOR | DEFERRED; structured scope controls routing, never words mined from why
conventions.acceptance_evidence: an ACCEPTED seam names a repository JSON record and hash; schema cordon-stage-b-acceptance-v1 records seam, reviewer, act and accepted_content_sha256 matching the manifest. This establishes a bound record, not authentication or the soundness of human judgment
conventions.dispositions.ref: one minted id, or an ordered list of successive versions of one target proposition when the source expression spans their intervals.
